summary: R. Venkatraman is a scholar in history, archaeology, and Indology. He earned his PhD at Madurai Kamaraj University (1975–1980) under doctoral supervisors N. Subrahmanian and N. Jagadeesan, and served as a reader there (attested 1990).

Rabindranath Tagore (1861–1941) worked in philosophy, religious studies, and other fields. He studied at St. Xavier's Collegiate School (~1875–1876) and University College London (~1878–1880), and founded Visva-Bharati University and the Sino-Indian Cultural Society.
Rachael Wiseman is a philosopher who studied at the University of York. She served as a lecturer at the University of Liverpool around 2016.

Rachel H. Pang is a scholar of Tibetology, Buddhist studies, and religious studies. She earned her PhD at the University of Virginia and was Lester D. Coltrane III Assistant Professor of Religious Studies at Davidson College (attested 2019).

Rachelle M. Scott works in Buddhist studies and religious studies. She completed her dissertation at Northwestern University under George D. Bond and Robert Launay, and held a post at the University of Tennessee (attested 2009–2017).

Radha Burnier (1923–2013) was an Indology and philosophy scholar. She studied at Kalakshetra and Banaras Hindu University, and served as Director of the Adyar Library and Research Centre (~1954–1980).

Radha Krishna Choudhary (1921–1985) studied history at Tej Narayan Banaili College and Patna University. An Indologist and historian, he founded the K. P. Jayaswal Archaeological Museum, headed history at Ganesh Dutt College, and taught at Tilka Manjhi Bhagalpur University (1974–1984).

Radha Kumud Mukherjee (1884–1963) was an Indologist and historian who studied at the University of Calcutta (~1901–1906). He held posts at Banaras Hindu University, the University of Mysore (~1917–1921), and headed history at Maharaja's College, Mysore (~1917–1921).

Radhika Herzberger (b. 1938) is an Indology and philosophy scholar. She earned her PhD at the University of Toronto (~1976–1982) under Bimal Krishna Matilal and served as Director of Rishi Valley School (~1980–2012).

Radoslav Katičić (1930–2019) was a linguist and Indologist who studied at the University of Zagreb (~1949–1954). He was a member of the Croatian Academy of Sciences and Arts (~1973–2019) and held a post at the University of Vienna (~1977–1998).

Rafal Stepien works in Buddhist studies and philosophy. He earned his PhD at Columbia University under Chün-fang Yü and Bernard Faure, and held appointments at Wadham College (2012–2013) and Harvard University (2015).

Rafał Felbur is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Sinology. A PhD candidate at Stanford University (attested 2015), he was supervised by Paul Harrison and taught by John R. McRae and Luis Oscar Gómez.
Raffaele Catà works in philosophy and Indology. He completed his laurea at the University of Bologna (2011–2012) under the supervision of Manlio Iofrida and Saverio Marchignoli.

Raffaele Torella (b. 1950) is an Indologist and philosopher who studied under Raniero Gnoli (~1970–1974). He served as a faculty member at Sapienza University of Rome (~1981–2020) and was Direttore responsabile of Rivista degli Studi Orientali (attested 2014).
Raffaello Orlando is a scholar in Sinology and Buddhist studies. He completed his PhD at Princeton University in 1981 under the supervision of Denis Twitchett.

Raghu Ananthanarayanan studied engineering at IIT Madras and philosophy and religious studies under Tirumalai Krishnamacharya and T. K. V. Desikachar. He taught at Krishnamacharya Yoga Mandiram and was a visiting faculty member at IIM Ahmedabad (attested 2010).

Raghu Vira (1902–1963) was a scholar of Indology, Iranian and Central Asian studies, and Buddhist studies. He earned degrees from Punjab, London, and Leiden, headed Sanskrit at Sanatan Dharma College (~1930–1946), and founded the International Academy of Indian Culture.

Raghunath Damodar Karmarkar (1893–1964) worked in Indology and philosophy. He was principal of Sir Parashurambhau College and served as professor and Director of the Post-Graduate and Research Department at the Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute.
Raghunath Giri was an Indology and philosophy scholar who studied under Vamacharana Bhattacharya. He served as a department head (科長) at Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith.

Rahul Peter Das (b. 1954), an Indologist and linguist, studied under Klaus Ludwig Janert and Albrecht Wezler, completing his degrees and habilitation at Hamburg. He researched and taught at Hamburg, Bonn, and Groningen before becoming a professor at MLU Halle-Wittenberg (~1994–2020).
